Details: Customers are eligible for a full 100% refund on all subscription purchases if the cancellation is requested within 24 hours of the initial transaction.
Payment gateway transaction fees (typically 2.9% + $0.30) are non-refundable and will be deducted from the total refund amount.
Once approved refunds are processed immediately. However it may take 5 to 10 business days for the funds to appear in your bank account depending on your financial institution.
If your refund has not posted after 10 business days you should contact our support team at support@ragopsplatform.com with your transaction ID.
Setup onboarding installation or custom configuration fees are completely non-refundable once the setup process has commenced.
